task.title: Enforce decision-to-roadmap propagation gates
task.summary: Make planning validation, graph/status, and audit evidence fail or route when accepted decision rows are not mapped to roadmap tasks, sprint metadata, knowledge-only completion, or explicit deferred owner/trigger records.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki prevents accepted semantic decisions from disappearing after partial planning by requiring deterministic decision-row propagation evidence before planning validation, implementation, or roadmap-empty task close can pass.
acceptance: Planning builds can represent accepted decision row resolution as knowledge-only, roadmap task, sprint/cohort metadata, or explicit deferred owner/trigger/rationale, and validation can inspect that evidence deterministically.
Planning validation fails or blocks incomplete row-to-roadmap propagation and requires a superseding planning build before implementation can consume the plan.
Graph/status/audit evidence exposes accepted decision builds with unmapped executable rows or downstream planning questions, including the TASK-010/file-structure regression as a fixture.
Roadmap-empty/task-close readiness routes back to planning when accepted decision residual work is unmapped.
Knowledge-only and explicitly deferred rows with owner/trigger/rationale do not create false failures.
Existing decision, planning, implementation, and task-close public tool behavior remains compatible except for the stricter propagation gate.
non_goals: Do not migrate source files to concept roots in this task.
Do not build the human file-structure UI surface in this task.
Do not create umbrella tasks that only coordinate other tasks.
Do not change public package commands.

delta.desired: Accepted decision rows must have durable propagation mappings and gateway enforcement before lower-layer work proceeds.
delta.current: TASK-010 planning left accepted source migration and human review surface work in open questions; the roadmap reached open=0 after close.
delta.closure: Task closes when the regression is covered by validation/state/audit checks and the propagation gap can no longer pass planning validation silently.
